title: A General Theory of Dynamic Mechanism Design with Endogenous Information and Hidden Actions
abstract: arXiv:2611.05692v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a general theory of dynamic mechanism design along two dimensions: joint endogeneity and interaction of hidden actions, information production, and disclosure; and generality across economic environments and feasibility structures. We accommodate correlated private information, interdependent preferences, and potentially infinite-dimensional allocations. We introduce joint perfect correlated Bayesian equilibrium, establish a dynamic revelation principle under this concept, and recursively characterize incentive compatibility. Focusing on a private-values environment allows us to characterize joint incentives through choice optimality, reporting-envelope first-order conditions, global integral monotonicity, and history-report incentives. We derive an exact dynamic information-rent identity, conditional revenue equivalence, and dynamic virtual surplus. Comparing first-best, two second-best, and third-best contracts distinguishes

translated_title: 内生信息与隐藏行为下动态机制设计的一般理论
translated_abstract: 我们沿着两个维度发展了动态机制设计的一般理论：一是隐藏行为、信息生产与披露的联合内生性及其相互作用；二是对不同经济环境和可行性结构的普遍适用性。该框架能够容纳相关联的私人信息、相互依赖的偏好以及潜在无限维的配置。我们引入了联合完全相关贝叶斯均衡的概念，在此概念下建立了动态显示原理，并递归地刻画了激励相容性。聚焦于私人价值环境，使我们能够通过选择最优性、报告包络一阶条件、全局积分单调性以及历史-报告激励来刻画联合激励。我们推导出了精确的动态信息租金恒等式、条件收益等价性以及动态虚拟剩余。通过比较一阶最优、两种二阶最优和三阶最优合约，区分了（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文建立了一个同时纳入内生信息、隐藏行为以及广泛经济环境适用性的动态机制设计一般理论，引入联合完全相关贝叶斯均衡并建立动态显示原理，进而推导出动态信息租金恒等式、条件收益等价性和动态虚拟剩余等核心结果。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a general theory of dynamic mechanism design encompassing endogenous information, hidden actions, and broad economic environments, introducing joint perfect correlated Bayesian equilibrium and a dynamic revelation principle, and deriving key results such as the exact dynamic information-rent identity, conditional revenue equivalence, and dynamic virtual surplus.
